rationale: The stock is trading at the absolute top of its daily range (99.2% position) and is pinned to the 9-EMA, indicating that the post-earnings gap-up has been fully extended with no immediate room for further upside before a potential mean reversion. Entering long here offers a poor risk-reward profile due to the proximity to the high and the lack of a clear breakout confirmation, while shorting into a strong momentum trend driven by positive earnings news carries significant counter-trend risk.
